children: Karman Holdings released an investor presentation highlighting a record $1.3B backlog and ~1.6x book-to-bill over the last 18 months.
Made investor presentation available on Sept. 16, 2026; presentation furnished as Exhibit 99.1 under Regulation FD.
Backlog reached $1.3B as of June 30, 2026, a ~69% increase since Q4 2024 excluding acquired backlog.
Reported ~1.6x book-to-bill ratio over the last 18 months, signaling strong bookings versus revenue.
Five strategic acquisitions since IPO expanded revenue, EBITDA and European footprint; typical acquisition EBITDA ~$11M at ~10x multiple.
Capital investments of ~$35–38M in 2026 to expand production capacity; expects positive cash flow generation in 2H 2026 and beyond.
